# SYNESIS_E140 — Error

## Description

BUNDLE (example_a, example_b) split across phases.

## Severity

An **error** stops compilation: no JSON, CSV or other export is written until it is fixed. Errors local to an `EXPORT` block are reported as warnings when compiling and stop only that block in `synesis export`.

## Compiler message

```text
`extraction`: the fields of the BUNDLE (example_a, example_b) are in different
  phases. Fields of a BUNDLE are produced together (the cross rule between
  them is lost when they are split).
```
